      Step 1 of 3
      1

      Follow the direct vector.

      The golden line joins the origin and destination. Enter a word connected to your last one; your brighter constellation will show how your route bends around that ideal line.

      OriginYour pathDestination
      2

      Every word becomes a star.

      Each accepted word stays visible and connects to the previous star in 3D space. After at least three bridge words, you can finish once your current star reaches the destination’s landing zone.

      3

      Finish—or improve your score.

      Once you find a bridge, choose to finish or keep improving. Route scores run from 0–100, and higher is better. An extra word helps only when it strengthens the route enough to outweigh the additional step. You have six bridge spaces and three undos.

      The game judges every move in the full 50-dimensional embedding. Only the final map is flattened into 2D.
